ex.en: He wishes to erase bad memories.
ex.zh: 他希望抹去不好的回憶。

ex.en: I erased the blackboard for the teacher.
ex.zh: 我幫老師擦黑板。

ex.en: I accidentally erased all the files on the drive.
ex.zh: 我不小心刪除了硬碟裡所有的檔案。

ex.en: The company's competitive edge will be eroded if system engineers continue to leave.
ex.zh: 如果系統工程師持續離職，公司的競爭優勢將會被削弱。

ex.en: This will erode our credibility.
ex.zh: 這會損害我們的信譽。

ex.en: The sea has slowly eroded the cliffs.
ex.zh: 海水慢慢侵蝕了懸崖。

ex.en: Correct the errors if there are any.
ex.zh: 如果有錯誤，請改正。

ex.en: My data-burning software is showing an error message.
ex.zh: 我的燒錄軟體出現錯誤訊息。

ex.en: Can you confirm that it is a correctable error?
ex.zh: 你能確認那是可以修正的錯誤嗎？

ex.en: The invention of the transistor marked a new era.
ex.zh: 電晶體的發明開啟了一個新時代。

ex.en: The revolution ushered in a new era.
ex.zh: 革命帶來了新時代。

ex.en: In the era of email, I'm so happy when a friend sends me a real letter.
ex.zh: 在這個電子郵件的時代，朋友寄給我一封真正的信，我會非常開心。

ex.en: The report was based on erroneous information.
ex.zh: 這份報告是根據錯誤的資訊寫成的。

ex.en: Many people hold the erroneous belief that shy people are unfriendly.
ex.zh: 許多人錯誤地以為害羞的人不友善。

ex.en: After all, even the gods may err at times.
ex.zh: 畢竟，即使是神也會偶爾出差錯。

ex.en: To err is human.
ex.zh: 犯錯是人之常情。

ex.en: Forgive me for being frank. You have erred.
ex.zh: 恕我直言：你犯了一個錯。

ex.en: I'm going to run a couple of errands. Wanna tag along?
ex.zh: 我要去辦幾件事，你要一起來嗎？

ex.en: Tom is out on an errand.
ex.zh: Tom出去辦事了。

ex.en: I asked my brother to run an errand to the post office for me.
ex.zh: 我請弟弟幫我跑一趟郵局。

ex.en: The office ordered ergonomic chairs for the staff.
ex.zh: 辦公室為員工訂購了符合人體工學的椅子。

ex.en: An ergonomic keyboard can reduce wrist strain.
ex.zh: 符合人體工學的鍵盤能減輕手腕負擔。
